newsitem.title: CANADA: Ford makes tentative deal with Canada union.
newsitem.headline: Ford makes tentative deal with Canada union.

text.p: Ford Motor Co.'s Ford Canada unit and the Canadian Auto Workers union reached a tentative contract agreement on Wednesday, ahead of a 7 p.m. EST 2400 GMT strike deadline, the union said.
"As of noon today, we have informed Mr. (Ford chief negotiator Donald) McKenzie that we have a tentative agreement," CAW President Buzz Hargrove told a news conference.
